sources.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: transparent Don't Starve Together cutout-animation facial overlay sheet.
Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET: current faces-v1.png, a 5-column by 3-row sheet of fifteen isolated eye-expression sprites. Correct ONLY its facial marks. Image 2 is the blank right-facing head that the profile eye must fit into (reference only).
Keep a transparent 1536x1024 canvas and exactly the same 5x3 uniform row-major grid. No head shapes, skin, masks or hair; this output is facial overlays ONLY.
CRITICAL FIXES:
1. Remove ALL little nose chevrons/nose strokes from every cell. These characters wear a mask over the nose. Transparent empty space must remain where the nose marks were.
2. The SIDE cells are row1 col5 and row2 col1, col2, col3 (zero-based frame4,5,6,7). Each must show only ONE right-facing PROFILE eye. The head faces RIGHT. Make the eye a horizontally compressed side-view eye, narrow angular almond/wedge, with iris/pupil near the RIGHT/front end looking to the right, with a sharp rightward inner corner. Do not paste a front-facing eye looking left. No second eye, no nose, no face outline. Match the existing bold scratchy black ink and muted icy gray iris. Preserve squint/blink variation in these four frames (frame6 near closed).
3. Other eleven cells retain their existing expression, eye-pair spacing, scale and sharp Wili style: row1 cols1-4 normal front and blink, row2 cols4-5 front, row3 col1 front, col2 sleeping/closed, col3 tired/angry, col4 crossed-out death eyes, col5 pale glowing special eyes. Front eye pairs should look balanced about their middle with level brow/eye baselines; do not give one eye a different tilt without expression reason.
Preserve cell occupancy, pose ordering and margins. Do not add glow to normal eyes, background haze, white rectangles, grid, numbers, text, or decorative elements. Genuine alpha transparency including every gap between eyes. Eye whites stay opaque. The ONLY drawing is the fifteen separate eye/brow expression components.
